name: git-commit
description: Draft concise Conventional Commit messages from staged changes, or commit the staged change set when invoked without draft mode.

interface.shortDescription: Draft messages or commit staged changes
interface.longDescription: Inspect only the current Git index, choose a concise Conventional Commit message, and commit on the current branch. Include draft for a message preview. Mixed unrelated changes require a decision before splitting or committing; index changes for a split require approval, and the skill does not push.
defaultPrompt: Use Git Commit draft to propose a Conventional Commit message for my staged changes.
Use Git Commit to commit my staged changes on the current branch.
